name: DateTheMoment
tagline: Sports team photos become months of marketing. Fully automated. Runs in the background.
rules: Never invent match results, player names, performance metrics, clients, prices or testimonials.
Never synthesize people, hands or faces in motion graphics.
Only use owner-approved sports photos; no scraped source images.
Preserve each club's voice; no generic recycled factual claims.
Human approval required before publishing anything.
Keep existing main-repository Make receiver; do not duplicate Supabase secrets or Telegram configuration.
No mountains, skiing, winter lodging, travel metaphors, ambient slow pacing or sleepy transitions.
Avoid unsupported promises of a fixed number of photos, posts or guaranteed growth.
verified_facts: Sports photography and online gallery delivery
Marketing automation for existing approved sports images

style_spec.reference: Kosowka-like graphic simplicity ONLY, not mountain, snow, holiday or slow/cozy pacing
style_spec.palette: White-first. Ink-black headlines. Royal blue calls to action; teal/orange used sparingly. Never green.
style_spec.visual_language: Spacious geometric 2D shape-based illustrations. Light UI icons and cards, no people/hands/faces, no mountains, no decorative stock.
style_spec.pacing: Crisp kinetic text and snappy 4-scene motion in 13 seconds. Smooth ease-out snaps, not slow ambient drift.
style_spec.story: Sports photos become captions from a PDF schedule, queued calendar posts and published social content. Fully automated in the background.
style_spec.brand_lockup: DATETHEMOMENT always appears. End with BOLD. No heavy ad CTA or invented metrics.

message_pillars: We turn sports teams' photos into months of marketing.
PDF schedule provides context for captions.
Fully automated. Runs in the background. BOLD.
